reviews.text: Excellent service. Everything is super organized and clean, and the team is fantastic. They explain everything and treat pets with care and respect.
Very friendly both on the phone and in the consultation.
Thanks for taking care of Violetta and Luigi!
I loved the treatment and care given to my pet.

I'm writing this review so that no one else has to go through what my dog ​​went through because of this clinic. I've been a customer for a while now with my two Chihuahuas, and it's becoming increasingly clear to me that here, making money takes precedence over the animal's well-being: unnecessary tests, blood they try to draw by pricking the dog six times without success and therefore without results, x-rays that lead nowhere… and when it really matters, they fail.

The last straw was this: I took my dog ​​in on a Friday with an eye ulcer, a serious problem that requires quick action. What did they do? They sent me home with "natural medicine" and a follow-up appointment two days later, as if it were nothing serious. The result: over the weekend, the infection worsened, and the ulcer grew enormous, a situation that could have been completely avoided with proper treatment or an immediate referral from the start. Because of their malpractice and their refusal to refer her in time, my dog ​​has suffered far more than necessary.

And the most outrageous thing: they charge you for the consultation on Friday, they charge you again on Monday, and in the end, they refer you to another clinic anyway. In other words, you pay twice for a diagnosis that was flawed from the start.

This clinic is of dubious reliability and prioritizes profit over the actual care of animals. I will never return, and I sincerely hope this review will make other pet owners think twice before trusting them. Your pets deserve better.
Great pet care, all the necessary scans, tests, and procedures were done, and my dog ​​was cured.

Exceptional service from everyone at the clinic. Very quick attention and solutions to all my questions and problems.
I just moved to the neighborhood and I already have a trusted vet to take my cats to.
They're super nice. My dog ​​hates the vet, and since we've been with them... I think he loves them more than me, hahaha.
Dr. Elna and her team are absolutely the best! They have huge hearts and care for your little one with complete integrity and love.
We were delighted with the care our dog received. They were excellent professionals and very friendly. We're so lucky to have them!
Very good. Everything was perfect. Manuel attended to us, he explained everything in great detail and gave our older dog a very thorough examination.
Fantastic professionals. Our dog received care unlike anything he'd ever received at any other clinic. A welcoming atmosphere and exceptional service. Highly recommended.

We've been taking our Luna to the clinic for 12 years, and I'm incredibly grateful. Javier, her vet since birth, just removed a huge tumor that was affecting her mobility. Thanks to his care and recommendations, she's enjoying a much better quality of life at her advanced age. She's happy and recovered. Thank you so much to everyone at the clinic for treating our fur babies so well. You're the best! 🫠😘
They charge you and perform unnecessary tests, and they don't solve anything. Terrible service.

We were incredibly professional and kind, from the doctors to the receptionists. The clinic is spotless. I'm absolutely delighted. They treat the animals with such wonderful love and care. I highly recommend it.
They are amazing professionals ❤️

Thank you so much for writing to us and for trusting our team for so many years. It's always a pleasure to see your four-legged family and continue caring for their health year after year!
Hugs!
Excellent clinic. All the staff are lovely, from the receptionists to the entire team. Special mention to Marina, who takes wonderful care of Floyd 🤍 …

I took my dog ​​back after his initial treatment in another town. I've known them for a long time, but thankfully it had been a while since I'd needed them until now. Thanks to their professionalism, advice, empathy, and genuine dedication, Manolito is improving by leaps and bounds. Years go by, but their reputation and professionalism remain unchanged. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.
I went to the clinic to ask for a quote for a cleaning. The doctor was very helpful, but I was amazed when they charged me for giving me a quote.

We've had Gara for almost a year now, and we couldn't be happier with the care she's received. They are very professional, they look after Gara with so much love and affection, and whenever we've had to go for an emergency, they've attended to us very quickly, even without an appointment. We highly recommend them.

Our sincere thanks to Javier and all the staff at the Labrador Clinic for their professionalism, empathy, and compassion in caring for our entire family, especially our animals—our kitten Pipín and all of Laura's. It was through her that we found you and discovered what we were looking for. Until next time, keep giving them life. Pipín's Family

Fantastic! I've been there countless times since I moved nearby, and they always see me as quickly as possible and find me an appointment very fast. I had Koda neutered there, and they advised and helped me with everything so I could always feel completely at ease with any questions. They answered all my doubts.

I highly recommend them. Thank you for treating us with such kindness and for making everything so easy.
Great professionals

Disastrous on several occasions. My dog ​​was diagnosed with Malassezia in July and prescribed medication that, three months later, we discovered was ONLY a corticosteroid; it didn't treat the Malassezia. As a result, my dog's condition worsened throughout the summer, and after taking him to another vet, we discovered the medication was incorrect. He was mistreated, and now the infection is much worse. Furthermore, we asked for help because we couldn't get the medication to work, and they didn't help us at all; they just left a note in the administration office, and that was it. At the new vet, we've been going down every day for 15 days to administer the medication, and it's free of charge.
The service is impersonal. You charge for everything, even cutting a single nail, and the service has been completely unprofessional, on several occasions.
And no, it's not true that you offered to come down there to administer the medication; that NEVER happened. I even asked to speak with the vet, who never called me back and left a note with the receptionist. I finally managed to speak with her because I kept insisting and calling repeatedly. And of course there was no follow-up appointment because you never told me to come in for one, and after the way I was treated, I changed vets. At least acknowledge your mistakes and tell the story as it happened.

They helped me with the export paperwork for my dog ​​so she could return to our country after our vacation.

Dr. Marina was very kind, efficient, and attentive.

They treated my dog ​​for a horrific illness in a horrific way. Specifically, one of the veterinarians, just two days before euthanizing him, performed an ultrasound and X-ray because he looked very ill. I then sent those same tests to a veterinarian I know, and he told me what was obvious in them. He said that if I wanted, he could give me a veterinary report from the university where he studied and graduated, specifying the evident negligence on this person's part in treating my child's illness. I had to record one of the hellish nights the poor creature endured to beg them to put him down. I never even received condolences from this person, which is the least of it. That's how it is; everyone speaks from their own experience. At some point, sooner or later, all creatures must go through that ordeal and transcend it. The difference is that we have our conscience as a life companion, and even if only for a second at the end of our existence, we are assailed by what is infamous or what we know was wrong. In our time on this earth, nothing is eternal, neither youth nor health.

I would never recommend them... I took my cat there more than three times and she always got worse... I had to go to another vet who helped my cat in no time... They'll never have an appointment unless you give them a lot of money... I felt not only cheated but also depressed seeing my cat sick and them only making it worse... If your pet is sick, don't take them there... There's another vet nearby with better professionals
They don't check the cats properly... terrible service and they only schedule appointments if you're going to give them a lot of money...

A center with excellent service and average prices (pet care is never cheap).
Veterinarian Marina is a true professional, and her dedication is evident in her personalized approach. The rest of the staff is also excellent. They have convenient opening hours. I highly recommend them.
Thank you, Marina, for being so attentive.

Ever since the shelter where I adopted one of my kittens recommended Labrador, I haven't changed vets. The care my three cats have received has always been excellent, even after many visits. Each of my cats has their own assigned vet, and I wouldn't trade them for anything. The attention is personalized; they always explain everything they're going to do and the reasons behind it. Furthermore, at least in my case, they always try to resolve issues without making you spend money on unnecessary tests. Yuumi, Morgana, and Godric are healthy and well cared for thanks to Labrador. I highly recommend them.

They helped my little dog who had a very upset stomach due to the Madrid heat and had been sick for several days. The vet who treated him was very careful and attentive, making sure not to overmedicate him and giving him exactly what he needed to recover. Excellent service and highly recommended!
Personalized service, they take great care of you and are very attentive. The facilities are fantastic. Highly recommended.
Excellent, the veterinarians are very nice, very professional and they treat the animals very well.
Very professional.

It's very good, they treat you with love and the clinic is well-equipped.
It's a shame that Dr. Elena, who was fantastic, is no longer there, but I'll continue taking my cats there anyway.

Excellent Vet 🫶🏻

We came on the recommendation of another client, and it was a fantastic choice.
Javier's approach is wonderful. He's not only gentle with the animals but also with their owners. He's very attentive and explains everything perfectly. You can tell he knows a lot, and that's much appreciated. He inspires confidence and trust.

We're thrilled. Rayo is in good hands.

The clinic is great; they have quality products, very affordable prices, and excellent service.

From now on, he's our trusted vet. 🫶🏻
My trusted clinic
We were looking for a comprehensive veterinary clinic close to home and we found it. We are delighted with the veterinarians, the service, and the results. I highly recommend them.
Great!!! They treat you with great friendliness and professionalism.
They are very professional and have excellent hands with animals.

We are so grateful and happy with how they treated our dog. We came in an emergency because she had broken a tooth, and they were very quick to schedule her surgery (there was no other option but to remove the tooth). Javier explained in detail what had happened and why it might have occurred. Everyone has been so kind to us, and you can really see the love and care they have for the animals. I definitely recommend anyone bring their pets here.
Service and professionalism
This clinic is our dog Pascal's regular veterinary clinic, and they have always treated him with care and affection. …
Very good and friendly veterinarians
Thank you for your support all these years ❤️
Since moving to the neighborhood, I've been taking my greyhound mix there. I went on a friend's recommendation, and after several bad experiences at other vets, I'm truly delighted with them. …

I hadn't planned to leave a review, but I think it's important to highlight both the good and the bad, especially when it comes to a service they offer that affects living beings, like our pets. In my case, I've taken my beagle to this …
Excellent care for my dogs!!
